description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则且关联了增强功能套餐的DDoS高防实例。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name, and the domain name must be associated with an instance that uses the Enhanced function plan. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

description.zh:
HTTP2.0的开关状态。取值：
- **0**：关闭
- **1**：开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. Valid values:

*   **0**: disables HTTP/2.
*   **1**: enables HTTP/2.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 设置网站业务转发规则的HTTP2.0开关状态

descriptions.zh: > 该接口仅适用于DDoS高防（中国内地）服务。
descriptions.en: >  This operation is suitable only for Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-http2-enable --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --enable 1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
